# Introduction

This document details temperature mortality curves for the CCUH cities using neighborhood level modifiers.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Libraries and plot theming."

# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
library(lubridate)
library(glue)
library(dlnm); library(gnm)

# Custom Library
library(SALURhelper)

# ggplot2 theming
theme_set(theme_classic())
theme_update(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             strip.background = element_blank(),
             strip.text = element_text(size = 12))
```

# Data

The cities we are analyzing include:

- Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
- Sao Paulo, Brazil
- Guatemala City, Guatemala,
- Panama City, Panama
- Philadelphia PA Metro, USA

Our data come from the [final data bundle](https://drexelccuh.quarto.pub/ms1__final_bundle__v1/). For this analysis we use the age separated data, i.e. deaths are grouped for those 0-64 and 65+. 

These data are aggregated at for each age category, neighborhood, year, month, and day. Note that our definition of neighborhood changes for different countries. In Brazil it is L2.5, in Guatemala and Panama it is L2, and in Philadelphia it is the DSPH PHL neighborhood definition for within Philadelphia proper and a CCUH modified neighborhood definition for the surrounding suburbs ([see documentation here](https://drexelccuh.quarto.pub/schema_ccuh_phl_metro_nbhd/)). 

For each row, we have the number of deaths, the population weighted temperature, the percent greenspace for that neighborhood, the percent of the population that completed primary school, and the population density.

The variables saved in:

- **age_category**: Identifies if deaths in row are for people <65 or 65+.
- **nbhd_geoid**: The neighborhood identifier used in analysis that has been harmonized across all countires.
- **year**: The year of the cases.
- **date**: Date of the cases.
- **death**: Number of deaths for a given neighborhood, date, and age range.
- **city_geoid**: The city identifier to which the neighborhood belongs.
- **city_name**: The name of the city to which the neighborhood belongs.
- **iso2**: The country in which the neighborhood resides.
- **popwt_temp**: Population weighted temperature in Celsius.
- **pct_green**: The percentage of land that is green space in a given neighborhood.
- **pct_educated**: The percentage of people that completed either primary school in Latin America or college in Philadelphia for a given neighborhood.
- **pop_density**: The population density in a given neighborhood.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Read in the data."

# Read a locally saved version
df <- read_csv(here("1-data", "merged_data_by_age1.csv"))

# Read directly from the database
# df_data_age <- "//files.drexel.edu/colleges/SOPH/Shared/UHC/Projects/CCUH/ccuh-server/freeze/_datawarehouse/v_0_1_0/ccuh_ms1__final_bundle_age__v1.parquet" |> 
#   arrow::open_dataset() |>  
#   dplyr::collect()

glimpse(df)
```

# No Modifiers

The first step in our analysis is to add a `strata` variable (age-category:nbhd:year:month:day-of-week) for use in fitting a conditional quasi-Poisson DLNM. In the following models, we estimate the temperature-mortality curve for each city.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Prepare data for analysis."

# We add a strata column to fit a conditional model
# We add a group column to ensure our cross-basis is correctly calculated
df <- df |> 
  filter(!(city_name %in% c("Belo Horizonte", "Campinas")),
         !is.na(popwt_temp)) |> 
  mutate(strata = paste(nbhd_geoid, age_category,
                        year(date), month(date), wday(date, label = TRUE),
                        sep = ":"),
         group = paste(nbhd_geoid, age_category, sep = ":"),
         pct_green_cen = pct_green/100 - .5,
         pct_educated_cen = pct_educated/100 - .5) |> 
  arrange(across(c(nbhd_geoid, date, age_category)))

# List of dataframes by city
list_df <- 
  split(df, df$city_name) |> 
  map(\(x) {
    mutate(x, across(c(age_category, nbhd_geoid, strata, group), factor))
  })

# Cities of interest
city_names <- names(list_df)

```

## Curves by City

```{r}
#| code-summary: "City-level analysis pooled at the nbhd-level."
#| eval: false

# Model
model_by_city <-
  map(list_df, \(df0) {

    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 3)

    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$popwt_temp, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = df0$group)

    # Fit city-specific model
    model <- gnm(death ~ cbt, 
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 #offset = log(POP),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)

    # Get exposure response curve/surface by city
    pred_list <- list(pred = crossreduce(cbt,
                                         model,
                                         cen = quantile(df0$popwt_temp, .75)))

    list(pred = crossreduce(cbt, model, cen = get_MMT(pred_list$pred)))

  })

# Save results
saveRDS(model_by_city, here("2-code", "city_fit_cen_at_MMT.rds"))

```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Generate plots of cummulative exposure response functions."
# Load models
model_by_city <- readRDS(here("2-code", "city_fit_cen_at_MMT.rds"))

# Values for plotting
min_temp <- min(df$popwt_temp, na.rm = TRUE)
max_temp <- max(df$popwt_temp, na.rm = TRUE)

min_RR <- min(map_dbl(model_by_city, \(x) min(x$pred$RRlow)))
max_RR <- max(map_dbl(model_by_city, \(x) max(x$pred$RRhigh)))

# Create list of plots
plot_by_city <-
  map2(model_by_city, city_names, \(pred_list, ID) {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- get_df_RRs(pred_list$pred) |> rename(Temperature = exposure)
    
    df0 <- df |>
      filter(city_name == ID, !is.na(popwt_temp))
    
    # Plot curve and histogram of observed temperatures by city
    p_curve <- df_plot |>
      ggplot(aes(x = Temperature)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RR_low, ymax = RR_high), alpha = .2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = RR)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
      scale_color_viridis_d() +
      scale_fill_viridis_d() +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_RR, max_RR), 
                         transform = "log", 
                         labels = \(x) round(x, 2)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min_temp, max_temp)
                         ) +
      labs(title = glue("{ID}"))

    p_hist <- df0 |>
      ggplot(aes(popwt_temp)) +
      geom_histogram(alpha = .2, bins = 35) +
      labs(title = "Observed Temperatures",
           x = "Temperature",
           y = "Count (in 1000s)") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) {x/1000}) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min_temp, max_temp)
                         )

    p_curve / p_hist
  })
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8

wrap_plots(plot_by_city, guides = "collect")
```

# Discrete Modifiers

Now we estimate the temperature-mortality curve for discretion modifiers. We try classifying neighborhood as being high or low (above or below the median) and high, medium, low (in tertiles). For these models we separate cases above and below 65 and model them separately.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Fit model with high and low modifiers"
#| eval: false

# Should cutoff be city-specific? Or using a general median percent green

# med_pct_green   <- median(df$pct_green)
# med_pct_primary <- median(df$pct_primary)
# med_pop_dens    <- median(df$pop_density)

interaction_model_by_city <-  
  map(list_df, \(df0) {
    # Define city-specific median points
    med_pct_green    <- median(df0$pct_green)
    med_pct_educated <- median(df0$pct_educated)
    med_pop_density  <- median(df0$pop_density)
    
    # Add categorical dummy variables
    df0 <- df0 |> 
      mutate(pct_green_low    = ifelse(pct_green    <= med_pct_green,    1, 0),
             pct_green_high   = ifelse(pct_green    >  med_pct_green,    1, 0),
             pct_educated_low = ifelse(pct_educated <= med_pct_educated, 1, 0),
             pct_educated_high= ifelse(pct_educated >  med_pct_educated, 1, 0),
             pop_density_low  = ifelse(pop_density  <= med_pop_density,  1, 0),
             pop_density_high = ifelse(pop_density  >  med_pop_density,  1, 0))
    
    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 3)

    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$popwt_temp, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = df0$group)
    
    # Fit Initial Model
    model <- gnm(death ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    # Interaction: greenspace
    cb_grn1 <- cbt * df0$pct_green_low
    cb_grn2 <- cbt * df0$pct_green_high
    
    # Interaction: education
    cb_edu1 <- cbt * df0$pct_educated_low
    cb_edu2 <- cbt * df0$pct_educated_high
    
    # Interaction: pop density
    cb_pdn1 <- cbt * df0$pop_density_low
    cb_pdn2 <- cbt * df0$pop_density_high
    
    # Model: greenspace
    model_grn1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn2) # Reference group: low
    model_grn2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn1) # Reference group: high
    
    # Model: education
    model_edu1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_edu2) # Reference group: low
    model_edu2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_edu1) # Reference group: high

    # Model: pop density
    model_pdn1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_pdn2) # Reference group: low
    model_pdn2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_pdn1) # Reference group: high
    
    # Predication
    temp_75 <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, .75, na.rm = TRUE)

    pred_list <-
      list(pred_grn1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_grn1, cen = temp_75),
           pred_grn2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_grn2, cen = temp_75),
           pred_edu1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_edu1, cen = temp_75),
           pred_edu2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_edu2, cen = temp_75),
           pred_pdn1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_pdn1, cen = temp_75),
           pred_pdn2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_pdn2, cen = temp_75))

    pred_list
    
    # list(pred_grn1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_grn1, cen = get_cen(pred_list$pred_grn1)),
    #      pred_grn2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_grn2, cen = get_cen(pred_list$pred_grn2)),
    #      pred_edu1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_edu1, cen = get_cen(pred_list$pred_edu1)),
    #      pred_edu2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_edu2, cen = get_cen(pred_list$pred_edu2)),
    #      pred_pdn1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_pdn1, cen = get_cen(pred_list$pred_pdn1)),
    #      pred_pdn2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_pdn2, cen = get_cen(pred_list$pred_pdn2)))
    
  }, .progress = TRUE)

saveRDS(interaction_model_by_city, "interaction_model_by_city.rds")

```

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Plotting function for interaction terms."

# Plotting function
plot_interaction_model <- function(ID, variable, model_list) {
  city_pred <- model_list[[ID]]
    
  if(variable == "Greenspace") {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- bind_rows(`Low` = get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_grn1),
                         `High`= get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_grn2),
                         .id = "category")
      
    
    # Color direction
    color_direction <- 1
    
  } else if(variable == "Education") {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- bind_rows(`Low` = get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_edu1),
                         `High`= get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_edu2),
                         .id = "category")
    
    # Color direction
    color_direction <- 1
    
  } else if(variable == "Pop Density") {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- bind_rows(`Low` = get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_pdn1),
                         `High`= get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_pdn2),
                         .id = "category")
    
    # Color direction
    color_direction <- -1
  }
  
  df_plot <- df_plot |> 
    rename(Temperature = exposure) |> 
    mutate(category = as.factor(paste(category, variable)))
  
  # Get y-axis limits
  min_RR_int <- min(df_plot$RR_low)
  max_RR_int <- max(df_plot$RR_high)
  
  # Data for temperature histogram
  # df0 <- df |>
  #     filter(city_name == ID, !is.na(popwt_temp))
  
  # Plot curve and histogram of observed temperatures by city
    p_curve <- df_plot |>
      ggplot(aes(x = Temperature)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RR_low, ymax = RR_high, fill = category), alpha = .2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = RR, color = category)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
      scale_color_viridis_d(direction = color_direction) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(direction = color_direction) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_RR_int, max_RR_int),
                         transform = "log", labels = \(x) round(x, 2)) + 
      scale_x_continuous(#limits = c(min_temp, max_temp)
                         ) +
      labs(title = glue("{ID}"), color = "", fill = "")

    # p_hist <- df0 |>
    #   ggplot(aes(temp_pw)) +
    #   geom_histogram(alpha = .2, bins = 35) +
    #   labs(title = "Observed Temperatures",
    #        x = "Temperature",
    #        y = "Count (in 1000s)") +
    #   scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) {x/1000})

    p_curve# / p_hist
  
}
```

# Multiple Interaction Models

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Fit model with high and low modifiers for multiple combinations at once."
#| eval: false

# Should cutoff be city-specific? Or using a general median percent green

# med_pct_green   <- median(df$pct_green)
# med_pct_primary <- median(df$pct_primary)
# med_pop_dens    <- median(df$pop_density)

multi_interaction_model_by_city <-  
  map(list_df, \(df0) {
    # Define city-specific median points
    med_pct_green    <- median(df0$pct_green)
    med_pct_educated <- median(df0$pct_educated)
    med_pop_density  <- median(df0$pop_density)
    
    # Add categorical dummy variables
    df0 <- df0 |> 
      mutate(pct_green_low    = ifelse(pct_green    <= med_pct_green,    1, 0),
             pct_green_high   = ifelse(pct_green    >  med_pct_green,    1, 0),
             pct_educated_low = ifelse(pct_educated <= med_pct_educated, 1, 0),
             pct_educated_high= ifelse(pct_educated >  med_pct_educated, 1, 0),
             pop_density_low  = ifelse(pop_density  <= med_pop_density,  1, 0),
             pop_density_high = ifelse(pop_density  >  med_pop_density,  1, 0))
    
    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 3)

    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$popwt_temp, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = df0$group)
    
    # Fit Initial Model
    model <- gnm(death ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    # Interaction: greenspace
    cb_grn1 <- cbt * df0$pct_green_low
    cb_grn2 <- cbt * df0$pct_green_high
    
    # Interaction: education
    cb_edu1 <- cbt * df0$pct_educated_low
    cb_edu2 <- cbt * df0$pct_educated_high
    
    # Interaction: pop density
    cb_pdn1 <- cbt * df0$pop_density_low
    cb_pdn2 <- cbt * df0$pop_density_high
    
    # Model: all combinations of green, edu, and pop dens
    model_1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn2 + cb_edu2 + cb_pdn2) # Reference group: low green, edu, pop dens
    model_2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn2 + cb_edu2 + cb_pdn1) # Reference group: low green, edu; high: pop dens
    model_3 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn2 + cb_edu1 + cb_pdn2) # Reference group: low green, pop dens; high: edu
    model_4 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn2 + cb_edu1 + cb_pdn1) # Reference group: low green; high: edu, pop dens
    model_5 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn1 + cb_edu2 + cb_pdn2) # Reference group: high green; low: edu, pop dens
    model_6 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn1 + cb_edu2 + cb_pdn1) # Reference group: high green, pop dens; low: edu
    model_7 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn1 + cb_edu1 + cb_pdn2) # Reference group: high green,edu; low: pop dens
    model_8 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn1 + cb_edu1 + cb_pdn1) # Reference group: high green, edu, pop dens
    
    # Predication
    temp_75 <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, .75, na.rm = TRUE)

    pred_list <-
      list(pred_1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_1, cen = temp_75),
           pred_2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_2, cen = temp_75),
           pred_3 = crossreduce(cbt, model_3, cen = temp_75),
           pred_4 = crossreduce(cbt, model_4, cen = temp_75),
           pred_5 = crossreduce(cbt, model_5, cen = temp_75),
           pred_6 = crossreduce(cbt, model_6, cen = temp_75),
           pred_7 = crossreduce(cbt, model_7, cen = temp_75),
           pred_8 = crossreduce(cbt, model_8, cen = temp_75))

    pred_list
    
  }, .progress = TRUE)

saveRDS(multi_interaction_model_by_city, "multi_interaction_model_by_city.rds")
```

# Tertile level modifiers

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Fit model with high, med, and low modifiers"
#| eval: false

# Should cutoff be city-specific? Or using a general median percent green

# med_pct_green   <- median(df$pct_green)
# med_pct_primary <- median(df$pct_primary)
# med_pop_dens    <- median(df$pop_density)

tertile_model_by_city <-  
  map(list_df, \(df0) {
    # Define city-specific median points
    tri_pct_green    <- quantile(df0$pct_green,    c(1/3, 2/3))
    tri_pct_educated <- quantile(df0$pct_educated, c(1/3, 2/3))
    tri_pop_density  <- quantile(df0$pop_density,  c(1/3, 2/3))
    
    # Add categorical dummy variables
    df0 <- df0 |> 
      mutate(pct_green_low = ifelse(pct_green <= tri_pct_green[1], 1, 0),
             pct_green_med = ifelse(between(pct_green,
                                                 tri_pct_green[1],
                                                 tri_pct_green[2]), 1, 0),
             pct_green_high = ifelse(pct_green > tri_pct_green[2], 1, 0),
             
             pct_educated_low = ifelse(pct_educated <= tri_pct_educated[1], 1, 0),
             pct_educated_med = ifelse(between(pct_educated,
                                                 tri_pct_educated[1],
                                                 tri_pct_educated[2]), 1, 0),
             pct_educated_high = ifelse(pct_educated > tri_pct_educated[2], 1, 0),
             
             pop_density_low = ifelse(pop_density <= tri_pop_density[1], 1, 0),
             pop_density_med = ifelse(between(pop_density,
                                                 tri_pop_density[1],
                                                 tri_pop_density[2]), 1, 0),
             pop_density_high = ifelse(pop_density > tri_pop_density[2], 1, 0))
    
    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 3)

    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$popwt_temp, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = df0$group)
    
    # Fit Initial Model
    model <- gnm(death ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    # Interaction: greenspace
    cb_grn1 <- cbt * df0$pct_green_low
    cb_grn2 <- cbt * df0$pct_green_med
    cb_grn3 <- cbt * df0$pct_green_high

    model_grn1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn2 + cb_grn3) # Reference group: low
    model_grn2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn1 + cb_grn3) # Reference group: med
    model_grn3 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_grn1 + cb_grn2) # Reference group: high
    
    # Interaction: education
    cb_edu1 <- cbt * df0$pct_educated_low
    cb_edu2 <- cbt * df0$pct_educated_med
    cb_edu3 <- cbt * df0$pct_educated_high

    model_edu1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_edu2 + cb_edu3) # Reference group: low
    model_edu2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_edu1 + cb_edu3) # Reference group: med
    model_edu3 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_edu1 + cb_edu2) # Reference group: high

    # Interaction: pop density
    cb_pdn1 <- cbt * df0$pop_density_low
    cb_pdn2 <- cbt * df0$pop_density_med
    cb_pdn3 <- cbt * df0$pop_density_high

    model_pdn1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_pdn2 + cb_pdn3) # Reference group: low
    model_pdn2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_pdn1 + cb_pdn3) # Reference group: med
    model_pdn3 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_pdn1 + cb_pdn2) # Reference group: high
    
    # Predication
    temp_75 <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, .75, na.rm = TRUE)

    pred_list <-
      list(pred_grn1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_grn1, cen = temp_75),
           pred_grn2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_grn2, cen = temp_75),
           pred_grn3 = crossreduce(cbt, model_grn3, cen = temp_75),
           pred_edu1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_edu1, cen = temp_75),
           pred_edu2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_edu2, cen = temp_75),
           pred_edu3 = crossreduce(cbt, model_edu3, cen = temp_75),
           pred_pdn1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_pdn1, cen = temp_75),
           pred_pdn2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_pdn2, cen = temp_75),
           pred_pdn3 = crossreduce(cbt, model_pdn3, cen = temp_75))

    pred_list
    
  }, .progress = TRUE)

saveRDS(tertile_model_by_city, "tertile_model_by_city.rds")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false

# Plotting function
plot_tertile_model <- function(ID, variable, model_list) {
  city_pred <- model_list[[ID]]
    
  if(variable == "Greenspace") {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- bind_rows(`Low` = get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_grn1),
                         `High`= get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_grn3),
                         .id = "category")
      
    
    # Color direction
    color_direction <- 1
    
  } else if(variable == "Education") {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- bind_rows(`Low` = get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_edu1),
                         `High`= get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_edu3),
                         .id = "category")
    
    # Color direction
    color_direction <- 1
    
  } else if(variable == "Pop Density") {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- bind_rows(`Low` = get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_pdn1),
                         `High`= get_df_RRs(city_pred$pred_pdn3),
                         .id = "category")
    
    # Color direction
    color_direction <- -1
  }
  
  df_plot <- df_plot |> 
    rename(Temperature = exposure) |> 
    mutate(category = as.factor(paste(category, variable)))
  
  # Get y-axis limits
  min_RR_int <- min(df_plot$RR_low)
  max_RR_int <- max(df_plot$RR_high)
  
  # Data for temperature histogram
  # df0 <- df |>
  #     filter(city_name == ID, !is.na(popwt_temp))
  
  # Plot curve and histogram of observed temperatures by city
    p_curve <- df_plot |>
      ggplot(aes(x = Temperature)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RR_low, ymax = RR_high, fill = category), alpha = .2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = RR, color = category)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
      scale_color_viridis_d(direction = color_direction) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(direction = color_direction) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_RR_int, max_RR_int),
                         transform = "log", labels = \(x) round(x, 2)) + 
      scale_x_continuous(#limits = c(min_temp, max_temp)
                         ) +
      labs(title = glue("{ID}"), color = "", fill = "")

    # p_hist <- df0 |>
    #   ggplot(aes(temp_pw)) +
    #   geom_histogram(alpha = .2, bins = 35) +
    #   labs(title = "Observed Temperatures",
    #        x = "Temperature",
    #        y = "Count (in 1000s)") +
    #   scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) {x/1000})

    p_curve# / p_hist
  
}
```
